title: Onboarding Report
description: How fast new hires complete paperwork, screenings and credentials.

generation.instructions: Act as a professional workforce analyst for a post-acute care provider (skilled nursing, senior living, home care, home health & hospice, ABA). This report covers Onboarding. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (locations, roles, staffing, compliance) more than restating the numbers themselves.

children.markdown: How fast new hires complete paperwork, screenings and credentials.

Fewer days from offer to completion means new hires can start on day one.

**Ask:** which steps still need HR to chase people?
On-time rate by category and the slowest tasks.

Background checks and fingerprinting depend on vendors, not the new hire.

Credential uploads are the most common late item for clinical roles.

**Ask:** can these start at offer instead of at hire?
Mobile self-service adoption and onboarding by location.

Mobile completion keeps rising - tasks done on the phone finish faster.

**Ask:** which locations lag on on-time completion?
